title: With Links on, links draw as curves between their boxes, and the edge hints count the linked records past each edge

title: A requirement's trace shows the fulfilling step, its flow and the components it uses
then: Expects the trace of a requirement to hold the step that fulfills it, its flow and the component it uses, in that column order, still laid out in columns.

title: Depth counts levels of the tree below the focus, stages and folders included, with the parent kept
when: Frames a requirement at depths 1 to 3 (the same picture: it has nothing below it), the Define stage at each depth (its folders, their records, their children), and an aggregate.
then: Expects the parent kept, each node's distance and the node it was reached from, only parent lines, and no sibling or link.

title: The Links switch adds the records the focused record links to and from, one hop, in focus, with their links
when: Turns Links on at a requirement.
then: Expects what satisfies, fulfills and proves it, one step away and reached from it, with their links and no ring of their own; none with Links off; only the focus's own links at depth 3; and the same result on every call.

title: Clicking a node re-centers the graph and changes the address, and Back walks back
when: Renders the graph page in jsdom, clicks a neighbor.
then: Expects the address, side bar and trail to change; then goes back and expects the first record again.

title: At depth 1 the graph frames the tree around the focus: its parent or folder at the left edge, its children or their folders, and no other links
when: Frames a use case in a folder, a domain, a use case with two kinds of children and a requirement at depth 1.
then: Expects the parent, the children or their groups, no siblings, and only parent lines.

title: The graph opens at depth 1, framing the parent and the children; depth 2 and 3 frame more levels below, and Links brings in the links
when: Opens the Define stage's graph.
then: Expects the depth buttons 1 to 3 with 1 pressed and no links, then depth 2 framing more records with a new summary; then a requirement's graph with Links on, its linked view and test drawn and a dashed link.

title: Depth counts levels below a domain and a use case, as a file explorer does
when: Frames a domain at depths 1 to 3.
then: Expects its stages, then their folders, then what is in them, one level more each time; and a use case in a capability, its capability the only node above it at every depth.

title: The Links switch is off by default, has a tooltip and the shortcut l, draws the center's links dashed, and is kept while walking
when: Opens a requirement's graph.
then: Expects the Links button unpressed with its shortcut, presses l, expects the linked records and three dashed link lines (and no tree line among them), then walks to the view and expects Links still on.

title: Stability: at depth 2 on a domain, the domain, its stages and their folders are framed in the canvas, each showing its full title wrapped on whole words
when: Opens the Exploring domain's graph at depth 2.
then: Expects, in the drawn scene, the domain, every stage and at least half the folders wholly in the canvas, and every framed box (the domain, its product at the left edge, its stages and their folders) labeled with its whole title, each of its lines fitting as drawn and every line but the last ending after a space or a hyphen.

title: The breadcrumb trail grows with each visit and cuts back on a revisit
then: Expects the trail to add new records, cut back to a record visited before, and keep only the most recent records.

title: Clicking a node re-centers the graph and changes the address, and Back walks back
when: Renders the graph page in jsdom, clicks a neighbor.
then: Expects the address, side bar and trail to change; then goes back and expects the first record again.

title: Nodes and lines show stage, relation, errors and gaps, with a legend
then: Expects each node drawn in its stage's colors, an error badge on a test with an error and none on a clean view, a gap badge on a rule with a gap, the lines' relation families, and a legend.

title: A domain node has the hexagon class and its outline, and the tree lines meet that outline
then: Checks the chamfer's growth and cap, a line out of a domain starting at the point's tip at its middle and on its slanted side above it, a line into a domain meeting the tip; and on a product's graph every domain node, and only domains, carrying the hexagon's class and its polygon outline, and the product its rounded box.

title: Stability: a domain is drawn as a hexagon, its outline the polygon in every state
when: Opens the product's graph.
then: Expects the domain drawn as its hexagon, its outline a six-cornered polygon; hovered, the same polygon in the hover state; focused, still the polygon, drawn as the focus; and the product drawn as a rounded box, not a polygon.

title: Every kind is drawn in its own shape, a group as a folder and a kind a product adds as a plain box, each shape keeping its label and badge clear of its notches and corners at every size, and the key shows every shape and mark
then: Expects every kind of the meta-model to have the shape and mark of the rule's table, a group a folder and an unknown kind a plain box, every shape and mark used and named in the key; on a leaf and on boxes grown with their level, a label as tall and wide as its padding and room allow, and its badge at the top right, inside every shape's outline; and each shape's outline, notch and room as the page draws them.

title: Stability: in the Tree view every label line and badge sits inside its box's shape, and in the Nested view every record shows its shape's mark
when: Opens a domain's graph in the Tree view at each depth, and for every drawn box big enough to read hit-tests, with the canvas's own hit test, the corners of each label line (at its drawn width) and each badge, expecting each to land on its own box, inside its polygon or rounded outline; then in the Nested view.
then: Expects every record box to be drawn with its kind's shape mark and no outline of its own.

title: Filters hide kinds and relations and paths through them, never the focus
when: Hides tests, then the satisfies relation, then views.
then: Expects the hidden records and lines to go, nothing to be reached through them, and the focus to stay even when its own kind is hidden.

title: The arrow keys step through the tree from a focused box, Enter re-centers on the box with keyboard focus, and Escape clears the filters
when: Focuses the center box and presses Left, Right and Down; presses Up on the canvas, and Left with Alt held; focuses another box and presses Enter; hides a kind and presses Escape.
then: Expects each arrow to move the focus with keyboard focus following from a box and staying on the canvas, Alt+Left to do nothing, Enter to re-center on the focused box, and Escape to show the hidden kind again.

title: Stability: every graph feature works the same in the Tree, Nested and Voronoi views
when: Runs one table of the graph's features in each view.
then: The Layout switch and its `v` command, a click to focus, Enter on a focused box, Tab through the drawn boxes with a visible focus ring, the plain Left arrow stepping out to the parent once the graph has focus, `.` framing the focus, depth 1 to 3, Links, a hidden kind keeping its space, the minimap, the trail, Back and Forward, the hover spotlight with Details following it, and the side bar's Outline; in the Nested view, every drawn child inside its parent's box on screen and the view kept for the session across a reload; and in the Voronoi view, every drawn cell a polygon whose label's middle the pointer finds it at, inside its parent's box on screen.

title: Columns follow the parent/child tree, and a trace has its own columns
then: Expects a requirement's ancestors in columns 0 to 3, the domain's other children beside the use case whatever their kind, every parent line running from one column to the next, and trace columns from the rule to the files, with a kind a product adds placed with the components.

title: The graph reads left to right by column, and so does a trace
then: Expects one x and one width per level of the map, levels left to right a gap apart, ancestors to the left of a record, and a trace's columns from the requirement to its files.

title: Links between records in one column are drawn but never change the map
when: Adds two aggregates that link to each other.
then: Expects them in one column with both links in the picture, and every box of the map where it was without the links.

title: The page draws the map in columns with a solid parent/child spine, and links between siblings never move anything
when: Opens a requirement's graph with Links on.
then: Expects the use case left of the requirement, the component and the test that link to it at their own places in the map, and a solid spine; then two sibling aggregates that link to each other, in one column, with both links drawn between them.

title: Siblings of mixed kinds share a column
then: Expects a component's sibling groups in one column and their members of several kinds in the next, every node with the same parent in one column, and a domain's open groups' members of eight kinds at one x position on the canvas.

title: Ancestors sit to the left of the focus and descendants to its right
then: Expects a use case's product, domain and group in columns 0 to 2, the use case in column 3 and its requirement in column 4, and the same order on the canvas.

title: A cross-linked record sits one column after its source
when: With parent lines hidden.
then: Expects a view one column after the requirement it fulfills and an endpoint one after the view; expects a test one column after the requirement it proves, unless the domain is shown, when it sits beside the use case as the domain's child.

title: Trace mode keeps its own columns
then: Expects every node of a requirement's trace in its kind's trace column, the requirement in column 0.

title: Focusing a child glides the camera on the shared motion, and no box moves or changes size
when: Opens a use case's graph, framed at once, clicks its requirement.
then: Expects the camera to glide there over several frames and end framing it, every box drawn before and after at the same place and size, and Back gliding back.

title: Under reduced motion focusing frames the new focus at once
when: Asks for reduced motion, clicks a requirement in its use case's graph.
then: Expects one camera move, straight to the framed view.

title: Stability: focusing anything moves the camera only, and no box changes its place or size
when: Focuses a domain, a stage, a folder, a capability and a use case by clicking, then goes Back twice and Forward once.
then: Expects each step stable, the camera different at each, and every box seen to keep the same place and size in the map throughout.

title: Hovering or focusing a box spotlights it, its lines and the boxes it joins, and leaving restores the picture
when: With Links on, focuses a linked view.
then: Expects it, the requirement and the line between them lit and the rest dimmed, and blurring it to restore the picture.

title: Stability: every graph feature works the same in the Tree, Nested and Voronoi views
when: Runs one table of the graph's features in each view.
then: The Layout switch and its `v` command, a click to focus, Enter on a focused box, Tab through the drawn boxes with a visible focus ring, the plain Left arrow stepping out to the parent once the graph has focus, `.` framing the focus, depth 1 to 3, Links, a hidden kind keeping its space, the minimap, the trail, Back and Forward, the hover spotlight with Details following it, and the side bar's Outline; in the Nested view, every drawn child inside its parent's box on screen and the view kept for the session across a reload; and in the Voronoi view, every drawn cell a polygon whose label's middle the pointer finds it at, inside its parent's box on screen.

title: With Links on, links draw as curves between their boxes, and the edge hints count the linked records past each edge
then: Checks the hints' arithmetic, then turns Links on for a requirement and expects every linked record drawn wherever it is, each link a curve, and the parent lines straight and level.

title: In the Tree view the plain arrow keys step through the tree once the graph has focus, and buttons step too, naming their keys
when: Reads the step targets of a use case, a folder and the product, then shows the graph and presses the arrow keys on its canvas, with Alt held on the page, and clicks the step buttons.
then: Expects Right to step in to the first child, Left out to the parent and Up to the previous sibling, each moving the graph's focus; the step buttons naming ArrowLeft and ArrowDown in aria-keyshortcuts; and nothing to step from a page-wide Alt+Down.

title: Each arrow takes its view's step: in Tree, Left out, Right in, Up and Down across; in Nested and Voronoi, Up out, Down in, Left and Right across; the siblings loop
given: A stage in the Graph view, which has a parent, a first child and a sibling either side, drawn in the Tree, Nested and Voronoi views in turn.
when: In each view, reads the step buttons, presses each of the four arrows on the canvas and goes Back after each, steps previous from the first stage and then next from the domain's last child, then opens the shortcuts sheet.
then: Expects each arrow to step where the view's mapping says, previous from the first sibling to reach the last and next from the last to reach the first, the step buttons in the same order in every view, each naming in aria-keyshortcuts and its mark the arrow that takes its step in that view, and each step's row in the sheet to list its Tree key and its Nested and Voronoi key.

title: Filters have a Minimap switch, off by default and kept while walking, and the minimap is an overview of the whole map
when: Opens Filters.
then: Expects a Minimap switch, off, no context ring switch, and the trace preset worded with the relations' labels; switches the minimap on and expects an overview of the map's upper levels, the focus solid and the view outlined, still there after walking on.

title: Stability: every graph feature works the same in the Tree, Nested and Voronoi views
when: Runs one table of the graph's features in each view.
then: The Layout switch and its `v` command, a click to focus, Enter on a focused box, Tab through the drawn boxes with a visible focus ring, the plain Left arrow stepping out to the parent once the graph has focus, `.` framing the focus, depth 1 to 3, Links, a hidden kind keeping its space, the minimap, the trail, Back and Forward, the hover spotlight with Details following it, and the side bar's Outline; in the Nested view, every drawn child inside its parent's box on screen and the view kept for the session across a reload; and in the Voronoi view, every drawn cell a polygon whose label's middle the pointer finds it at, inside its parent's box on screen.

title: Depth shows only in the Tree layout
when: Opens a stage in the Tree layout.
then: Expects the Depth buttons shown. Switches to Nested and then Voronoi, and expects the Depth group to keep its slot but be hidden, aria-hidden and inert, so it is neither seen nor reached. Switches back to Tree and expects it again.

title: Stability: every graph feature works the same in the Tree, Nested and Voronoi views
when: Runs one table of the graph's features in each view.
then: The Layout switch and its `v` command, a click to focus, Enter on a focused box, Tab through the drawn boxes with a visible focus ring, the plain Left arrow stepping out to the parent once the graph has focus, `.` framing the focus, depth 1 to 3, Links, a hidden kind keeping its space, the minimap, the trail, Back and Forward, the hover spotlight with Details following it, and the side bar's Outline; in the Nested view, every drawn child inside its parent's box on screen and the view kept for the session across a reload; and in the Voronoi view, every drawn cell a polygon whose label's middle the pointer finds it at, inside its parent's box on screen.

title: In the Voronoi view the camera frames the focus cell, and the page draws each cell as its outline
when: Frames the product, a domain and a use case in the Voronoi map on a canvas of 1000 by 800.
then: Expects the focus's box centered, every drawn cell in view and at least 3 pixels across, a parent drawn before its children, the drawing within its budget and the focus drawn. On the page, with the Voronoi layout chosen, expects each cell drawn as its polygon with its label inside, the pointer finding the cell at its label's middle and not at a corner of its bounding box outside its outline, and a click on a child gliding the camera to frame its cell.

title: A record with several kinds of child has a labeled, counted group per kind
then: Checks which records are grouped (only those with more than one kind of child, however many of one kind), the groups' labels such as "Requirements (6)", their members, and that a group's ID is its parent and kind and names no record.

title: Every group is in the map with all its members beside it, and the spine runs record, group, record
when: Frames a domain at depths 1 and 2.
then: Expects its stages and folders as groups with their counts, the spine running through a group to its records, every group in the map holding all its members right beside it and spanning them exactly, and cross-links running record to record.

title: Trace mode has no groups, and filters hide groups with their kind or the parent relation
then: Expects no groups in a trace, no group for a hidden kind, no groups at all when parent/child is hidden, and the same graph every time.

title: A group shows its name and count, with no chevron; clicking a group, or Enter on it, goes to it
when: Opens a domain's graph.
then: Expects the open questions' group drawn as a folder with no chevron and no button; clicks the group and expects its address, the group the center, and its name and count in its tooltip; goes back and presses Enter on a stage and expects its address.

title: Groups are drawn as folders with marks for trouble beneath them, and the legend explains them
when: Renders a domain.
then: Expects error and gap marks on the groups with trouble beneath them, none on a clean group, an accessible label that says folded, and a legend entry for groups.

title: The graph's tree is the nav's tree
then: Expects a domain's stages and folders in the nav's order and counts, Capabilities as one list, a capability's use cases as its children with its test in the Test plan, Interaction design split by kind, Technical specification's layers then components, the product's Shared folder before its domains, and every child's parent to be the node that lists it.

title: A group shows its name and count, with no chevron; clicking a group, or Enter on it, goes to it
when: Opens a domain's graph.
then: Expects the open questions' group drawn as a folder with no chevron and no button; clicks the group and expects its address, the group the center, and its name and count in its tooltip; goes back and presses Enter on a stage and expects its address.

title: A group can be the focus: its parent and all its members are shown, and depth counts levels from it
when: Centers on the Capabilities folder.
then: Expects its stage and every member, the spine through it, the members' children and groups framed at depth 2 and their members at depth 3, nothing for a group that does not exist, an older kind group's address still working, and its `/<domain-id>/<stage>/<folder>` address both ways, the old `/graph/...` one leading there.

title: A group has its own address with its parent left and its members right, and Back works
when: Follows the domain panel's link to a group.
then: Expects the group's address, panel, columns and trail (the domain as "Domain (P-D)", the group as "Use cases" with its parent in the tooltip), follows a member and goes Back to the group; then expects a message for a group that does not exist.

title: A stage or folder group page names the group by its own name, not by a kind
when: Opens a domain's Define stage page.
then: Expects its intro and the side bar to say "Define", never "Defines".

title: A group carries a summary mark for problems and gaps beneath it
then: Expects the aggregates' group to carry the warnings and gaps of the rules beneath the aggregate, the tests' group to carry the test's error, and the use cases' group nothing.

title: Groups are drawn as folders with marks for trouble beneath them, and the legend explains them
when: Renders a domain.
then: Expects error and gap marks on the groups with trouble beneath them, none on a clean group, an accessible label that says folded, and a legend entry for groups.

title: Groups take their own column between the parent and its children
when: Lays out a group's neighborhood.
then: Expects the parent, the group, its members, a member's own group and its members from left to right, a member's group beside another member's ungrouped child, and every group one column after its parent and one before its members.

title: A group sits in its own column between its parent and its members
then: Expects a domain, its use case group, the use cases, a use case's requirement group and its opened members each one column further right, the group beside another use case's ungrouped requirement.

title: An aggregate's events sit under it in a Domain events group, and with Links on their raises and hears links are drawn, labeled from the meta-model
then: Expects the aggregate's Domain events group with its count, the event under it, its raises and hears links drawn only with Links on, and labeled Raised by and Heard by.

title: A parent spans its children stacked, an equal part each, from its top edge to its bottom edge, each child beside it, nothing overlapping
when: Builds the maps of three workspaces, two synthetic trees and a product with a busy part and a quiet one.
then: Expects every root the product box's height, every parent's children of one height, stacked from its top to its bottom a tenth of each one's part apart, each in the next level right of it, no two boxes in a level overlapping, the busy part and the quiet one the same height with the busy one's children smaller, and the tree the nav's.

title: Tall parents carry their height and text scale, every box its text scale as its box scale, and every parent line is level
when: Opens a domain's graph at depth 2.
then: Expects, in the drawn scene, the domain taller than its stages stacked with a text scale above 1, every drawn box's box scale its text scale, and every parent line drawn level.

title: Stability: at depth 2 on a domain, every framed box shows its full title wrapped on whole words
when: Opens the Exploring domain's graph at depth 2.
then: Expects every framed box (the domain, its product at the left edge, its stages and their folders) labeled with its whole title, each of its lines fitting as drawn and every line but the last ending after a space or a hyphen.

title: Stability: no label is clipped, in light and dark, focused or not, at several zooms
when: In light and dark, on the Exploring domain and its Define stage at depths 1 to 3 and zoomed in twice.
then: Expects every drawn box in the canvas to fit each of its lines, read from the drawn scene: each line's width as the canvas measures it at its drawn font at most its placed width, and the line inside its box, with half a map unit and half a pixel to spare.

title: Stability: a label keeps its size in the map when the focus changes
when: Opens the Exploring domain's graph, reads its Design stage's title font size in the drawn scene and its lines, then focuses the stage.
then: Expects the font size in map units and the lines unchanged, and the title's size on screen to change only with the camera's zoom.

title: Pattern rules sit under their pattern in the graph
then: Expects parent lines from the pattern to its rules and each rule one column to the pattern's right.

title: Follows is drawn as a cross-link
then: Expects follows lines shown and styled as pattern links, and each use case reached from the pattern by one sitting a column after it, the link laid out pointing right.

title: Trace mode for a pattern rule
then: Expects trace mode offered for a pattern rule, not a pattern, with what satisfies and proves it in every domain.

title: A pattern's Graph view draws its rules and follows lines
when: Opens a pattern in the Graph view.
then: Expects its rules drawn, a follows line in the pattern style, and the legend naming it.

title: A flow step sits one column right of its flow, joined by the parent line
then: Expects a flow's three steps in its neighborhood, joined to it directly, all in the column after it.

title: A flow's steps hang under it directly, or through a group beside other kinds
then: Expects a flow with six steps and nothing else to reach them directly, and one that also has an interaction requirement to reach them through a "Flow steps (6)" group in the next column, its steps framed at depth 2, and in the map each step under the group and the group under the flow.

title: A requirement's trace shows the fulfilling step, its flow and the components it uses
then: Expects the trace of a requirement to hold the step that fulfills it, its flow and the component it uses, in that column order, still laid out in columns.

title: A domain reaches its technical records through Technical specification, then a folder per kind
then: Expects the domain's Technical specification stage, its kind folders, and a repository and a command handler under theirs.

title: A domain reaches its tests through Test plan, then a folder per test kind, as the nav does
then: Expects the domain's Test plan stage, each of its folders holding tests of its own kind, and a flow test under Flow tests.

title: The trail names a record by its title and ID, a group by its name alone, the full text in its tooltip, the current item bold
when: Opens a use case's graph, then a group's.
then: Expects the use case as its title with its ID in code, the group by its name with no count, its parent in its tooltip and accessible name, and the stylesheet cutting a long name with an ellipsis and keeping the current item bold.

title: Trace mode shows what fulfills, satisfies and proves a requirement, and its files
then: Expects the trace chain of a requirement to hold its view, component and test, the component implementing the view, and the two files they name, and nothing else.

title: The trace switch shows only the chain for a requirement and is absent for a use case
when: Switches on trace mode for a requirement.
then: Expects the file nodes to appear and the parent use case to go; Escape leaves trace mode; on a use case there is no switch.

title: A UC requirement's trace starts from the business outcomes its capability serves, each in a column of its own
then: Expects the outcome, the capability and the use case left of the requirement, in their own columns, and the outcome gone when serves is hidden.

title: Trace mode is offered only for requirements and domain rules
then: Expects trace mode to be available for a requirement and a domain rule and for no other kind.

title: The graph draws a standard as a pattern with a ruler in Shared and meets as a design line in its key
then: Expects the standard under its product's Shared folder with its rules under it, drawn in the Design stage's colors as stacked boxes and its rules as octagons, each with a ruler mark, `meets` in the design line style, and the key's Design, shape, ruler and design line entries naming them.

title: In each layout, the arrows, a click, Enter, a tab and Back keep the layout, depth and Links, in tabs open or new
given: A lasting tab on a flow drawn as it starts, and a lasting tab on its first step where the person set depth 2, Links on and the layout (Tree, Nested or Voronoi).
when: Steps out, in, next, previous, next and out, each by the arrow that takes that step in the layout (LA-V93-R19), into the open tabs and into pages no tab holds, clicks a box, presses Enter on one, activates a tab and goes Back.
then: Expects the toolbar to show the layout, depth and Links the person set after every move, and the session to hold them; then v changes the layout.

title: Stability: in each layout, the arrows and clicks keep the layout, depth and Links, into tabs open or new
given: In Chromium, a lasting tab on LA-EXP-UC03-FL01 drawn as it starts, and a lasting tab on its first step where the person set depth 2, Links on and the layout (Tree, Nested or Voronoi).
when: Steps out, in, next twice, previous twice and out, each by the arrow that takes that step in the layout (LA-V93-R19), across the open tabs and steps no tab holds, and clicks the boxes of steps open in a tab and not, stepping out by the layout's arrow after each.
then: Expects the graph's layout, the pressed layout and depth buttons and the Links switch unchanged after every move.

title: The graph's settings last the session: the Links switch comes back on reload
when: Turns the Links switch on, then reloads the page.
then: Expects the switch still on.

title: A domain's ERD draws a referenced aggregate of another domain as a closed box, gray and faded, labeled with its domain
when: Builds a domain's ERD.
then: Expects the other domain's aggregate as a closed, faded box with its domain's name, and on the page that box out of focus and labeled "Aggregate · Accounts".

title: An aggregate's ERD draws the aggregates it references as closed boxes, faded, with a dashed line from each referring entity
when: Builds an aggregate's ERD.
then: Expects the referenced aggregates as closed, faded boxes of the current domain and a dashed line from each referring entity; then draws it and expects them faded.

title: A domain's ERD draws each aggregate as a boundary around its entities with their fields, has one and has many lines with crow's feet, and a dashed reference from an entity to another aggregate's root
when: Builds a domain's ERD.
then: Expects only aggregates and entities, each aggregate a boundary around its entities with the root marked and each field's type, the has one and has many lines with their ends, one dashed reference line per entity and referenced aggregate ending at its root, each entity laid out inside its boundary; then draws it and expects the boxes' names, the fields, no command, event or policy box, and the lines' tooltips.

title: An aggregate's ERD shows each entity's title, root mark and fields with their types, has one and has many lines with crow's feet, and its references to the aggregates around it
when: Builds an aggregate's ERD.
then: Expects its boundary, its entities with the root first, the referenced aggregates faded, one-one, one-many and dashed reference ends, lines from box edge to box edge and fanned apart; then draws it and expects the root mark, the fields list and the ends.

title: An entity page draws its aggregate's ERD with the entity highlighted
when: Opens a child entity in the Model view.
then: Expects its aggregate's ERD with only that entity highlighted, and the key naming it.

title: Clicking a box goes to it, boxes show a hover state, and a key under the diagram lists only the boxes and lines drawn
when: Opens a domain with the wiki and model.
then: Expects the key under the diagram to list Entity, Root entity, Aggregate boundary and Other domain, then Has one, Has many and Reference by ID, clicks an aggregate's box and expects its page with the same views, presses Enter on an entity's box and expects its page, and expects the hover ring, its speed and the domain model stage's tokens in the stylesheet.

title: An aggregate's ERD fades the aggregates it references and those that reference it; a domain's ERD fades other domains' aggregates
when: Builds the ERDs of an aggregate referenced by two others, of another domain's aggregate and of a domain.
then: Expects the two referencing aggregates faded with a dashed line each to the root, labeled with their fields, the referencing aggregate of another domain gray and labeled with its domain, and the domain's ERD fading only the other domain's aggregate.

title: The opening frame fits every box, faded ones included, inside the margin at any canvas size, and the faded boxes are out of focus
when: Lays out an aggregate's ERD and fits it to three canvas sizes, then draws it.
then: Expects every box inside the margin at a zoom of at most 1 at each size, and on the page the faded box hidden from assistive technology and the key explaining it.

title: In the Wiki view Details shows only what the page does not: the data file and line, the columns of its row and the raw links; a focused or right-clicked record row shows that record
then: Expects the data file and line, the columns of its row and the raw links, and no children, problems or identity block; a record row with focus shows that record as "Selected" until focus leaves; a right-clicked row stays until a click elsewhere.

title: In the Graph view the side bar shows kind, title, problems, gaps and a page link
when: Centers the graph on a rule with problems and gaps.
then: Expects the side bar's Details to show its kind, title and problems, its gaps in its compact Traceability, and a link to the record page.

title: The side bar shows the record in the Graph view and folds away, remembered per view mode
then: Expects the side bar open in a record's Graph view with the record and what the graph connects, hides it with its own button, expects the main view to take the space and the choice remembered in the Graph view of another record, shows it again and expects that record, and expects the Wiki view still closed, its own choice.

title: On a narrow screen the side bar is a bottom sheet
when: With a narrow screen, opens the side bar from the page bar.
then: Expects a bottom sheet with focus inside, closes it with Escape and expects focus back on the toggle.

title: The side bar is a bottom sheet: it opens at half height with focus inside, its handle takes it to full height and back, Escape closes it and focus returns
when: On a phone, opens the side bar from the page bar.
then: Expects a modal bottom sheet at half height with the side bar focused, full height and back from the handle, Tab kept inside, and Escape closing it with focus back on the toggle.

title: The side bar's switcher, its headings, and its state per view mode and per tab across a reload
then: Expects the side bar closed in the Wiki view and open on Details in the Graph view, a "Side bar views" group of three pressed-or-not buttons, each view under its heading, focus kept on the button pressed, Outline still chosen in the Graph view after a reload, and the Wiki view of the same tab still closed.

title: The side bar shows the record in the Graph view and folds away, remembered per view mode
then: Expects the side bar open in a record's Graph view with the record and what the graph connects, hides it with its own button, expects the main view to take the space and the choice remembered in the Graph view of another record, shows it again and expects that record, and expects the Wiki view still closed, its own choice.

title: On a phone the side bar is a bottom sheet with the same three views
when: On a narrow screen, opens the side bar from the page bar.
then: Expects a sheet holding the "Side bar views" switcher, and Outline shown under its heading when chosen.

title: The side bar's switcher, its headings, and its state per view mode and per tab across a reload
then: Expects the side bar closed in the Wiki view and open on Details in the Graph view, a "Side bar views" group of three pressed-or-not buttons, each view under its heading, focus kept on the button pressed, Outline still chosen in the Graph view after a reload, and the Wiki view of the same tab still closed.

title: In the Graph view Details follows the node under the pointer or keyboard focus, then the page's record
then: Expects the page's record with its compact Traceability, data file and what the graph connects; a hovered node's details with "Under the pointer" and Open at its address; the page's record back on leaving, in the same box; and the same for a node with keyboard focus.

title: In the Wiki view Details shows only what the page does not: the data file and line, the columns of its row and the raw links; a focused or right-clicked record row shows that record
then: Expects the data file and line, the columns of its row and the raw links, and no children, problems or identity block; a record row with focus shows that record as "Selected" until focus leaves; a right-clicked row stays until a click elsewhere.

title: Outline lists the wiki's sections, scrolls to one and marks it, and lists the Model view's boxes
then: Expects the wiki's Traceability and Problems sections among the outline's rows, a click to scroll the wiki pane and mark that row `aria-current="location"`, and a domain's Model view outline to list its aggregates as whole-row links.

title: History lists the file's commits, the uncommitted change first, shows a diff inline and loads more
when: With the history API answered in the test.
then: Expects "Not committed" first and then twenty commits with date, author and short hash; the uncommitted diff inline with its removed, added and header lines marked; one diff open at a time; Load more adding the rest; and the calm message when the folder is not a git repository.

title: Stability: switching the side bar's view and hovering graph nodes moves nothing outside the side bar
when: On a record with the wiki and the graph open, switches the side bar to Outline, History and Details, then hovers three nodes and leaves.
then: Expects no unexpected layout shift and the nav, the pane bars and titles, the graph's header and canvas, the side bar and its switcher to keep their boxes.

title: Record, domain and product pages show the graph in their Graph view, and the nav has no Graph item
when: Opens a record page, a domain page and a product page.
then: Expects no Graph item in the nav, and expects each page's Graph view to show its graph at the right address.

title: The nav has no Graph item and the graph stays a view away
then: Expects no Graph item in the open nav or the rail, the page's Graph view, Ctrl+2 and the palette's Graph view command.

title: The graph is a component that reports moves through a callback and fits a resized container
when: Renders the graph view on its own with a callback and its own link addresses, clicks a node and a panel link.
then: Expects the callback, not an address change; then resizes its container and expects the picture fitted again.

title: A record and a group each have one address, in every view
when: Parses record and group addresses at their bare IDs, builds the address of a record, a group and a domain.
then: Expects `?view=split` to name no view, then opens a record in the Graph view at its ID and a group page at its own address.

title: An old address is no page: /records, /specs and /graph addresses say so, and the address stays as typed
when: Opens `/records/<id>`, `/records/<parent>/<kind>`, `/specs`, `/specs/<product>/<domain>`, `/graph` and `/graph/<id>`.
then: Expects each to read as a missing page, to say there is no such page, and to keep its address. Then opens a record with `?view=split` and expects no Graph pane, as `split` names no view.

title: The view toggles open and close panes, at least one stays open, and the open views are remembered and named in the link
when: Opens a record with the wiki alone.
then: Expects no Split or Open beside, clicks Wiki and expects it to stay open with a tooltip that says why, opens the graph beside it and expects `?view=wiki,graph` and the panes in order, closes the wiki, opens another record and expects the graph again, then opens `?view=wiki,graph` and expects the wiki and the graph, remembered as `wiki,graph`, with the View toggles once, in the page bar.

title: Switching views by keyboard keeps focus, and the toggles show a focus ring
when: Focuses a button in the graph pane, closes the graph with Ctrl+2.
then: Expects focus on the Graph toggle, now in the wiki pane's bar; checks the toggle tooltips (Alt+G off a Mac) and the focus ring style.

title: The page bar holds the page's tabs and layout controls; each pane's header holds only that pane's actions, on wide and narrow screens
when: Opens a record alone, with the wiki and graph, and with both on a phone.
then: Expects one page bar, outside every pane and the side bar, holding the tab strip at its left (on a phone, the Open pages button instead), and at its right the one "View" group of `aria-pressed` toggles, one pressed per shown pane, with the side bar toggle last. On a wide screen each pane is a panel whose first child is its slim header: a non-interactive label naming its view, and only its close button (when more than one pane is open) and its full screen button, all icon buttons, with no tabs or groups in it. On a phone one pane shows, with no header. The title sits in the leftmost pane, and the stylesheet gives the page bar and the pane headers fixed heights.

title: Every gap between open panes moves by keys, is remembered and resets evenly, and a pane goes full screen until Escape
when: Moves the gap between the wiki and the graph with the arrow and End keys.
then: Expects each pane's weight in the grid with its least width and the weight remembered, double-clicks and expects an even share, puts the graph pane full screen, expects focus on its button, presses Escape and expects the panes back with focus on the full screen button.

title: Both panes follow one focus, Back moves both, and graph settings survive
when: With the wiki and graph open, follows a child link in the wiki.
then: Expects the graph re-centered, clicks a node and expects the wiki and title to follow, goes Back and expects both to return, and expects depth 2 kept across pages and a trip to the Wiki view.

title: A group page shows its parent, kind and members with their marks
when: Opens a group of domain rules.
then: Expects the parent link, the kind's description, and each member with its gap marks and problem badge.

title: Product and domain pages have the views, the graph centered on them
when: Opens a product and a domain with the wiki and graph open.
then: Expects a wiki pane and a graph centered on the product or domain.

title: A product's and a domain's one page, at its ID, shows its text, its facts, its links both ways and its problems
when: Opens a product and a domain at their IDs.
then: Expects its text in the wiki, the parent, data file, links out, links in and problems in the side bar, and no link to a second overview page.

title: Above a graph or a model pane the page title keeps one fixed height; in the wiki pane it wraps
when: Opens an aggregate in the Graph view and an entity in the Model view.
then: Expects the title area to have the fixed-height class, with the whole title as its tooltip and a set height, one line each, in the stylesheet; with the wiki open on the left it does not.

title: A plain open replaces the one preview tab in place, a page open in a tab activates it, and keeping makes a tab lasting
when: Opens pages in an empty tab set.
then: Expects each plain open to replace the preview tab where it sits, keeping its key, with its state made from the tab that was active; a kept tab to stay when the next page opens beside it; a page already open to activate its tab; a kept open to add a lasting tab after the active one; and never two previews or two tabs for one page.

title: A plain open replaces the italic preview tab, a double-click keeps it, a page already open activates its tab, and Back reopens a closed page as the preview
when: Opens a record.
then: Expects one preview tab with its ID in mono, labeling the tab panel; follows a wiki link and expects the preview replaced; double-clicks it to keep it and expects the next page in a new preview beside it, a group's tab with its label and no ID; follows a link to the kept page and expects its tab active, no second tab; clicks a tab and expects the address to follow; closes it, goes Back and expects it reopened as the preview.

title: A page opened shows in a tab: a link to an open page activates it, and Back reopens a closed page as the preview
when: Opens a record, follows links, keeps a tab, opens a group, and closes it.
then: Expects one preview tab replaced in place, a group's tab with its label and no ID, a link to a kept page activating its tab, and Back reopening a closed page as the preview.

title: A plain open replaces the italic preview tab, a double-click keeps it, a page already open activates its tab, and Back reopens a closed page as the preview
when: Opens a record.
then: Expects one preview tab with its ID in mono, labeling the tab panel; follows a wiki link and expects the preview replaced; double-clicks it to keep it and expects the next page in a new preview beside it, a group's tab with its label and no ID; follows a link to the kept page and expects its tab active, no second tab; clicks a tab and expects the address to follow; closes it, goes Back and expects it reopened as the preview.

title: Ctrl+Tab and Ctrl+Shift+Tab cycle, the keep command keeps the preview, and on the focused strip the arrow keys move and Delete closes
then: Expects the four tab commands in the keymap; keeps the preview with Alt+K then Enter (off a Mac); cycles with Ctrl+Tab and Ctrl+Shift+Tab; expects only the active tab in the Tab order, the arrow key to move focus, Enter to activate and Delete to close the focused tab, with focus left on the tab now active. Expects the active tab's close button to carry the close command's keys.

title: Switching a preview tab's views keeps it open
when: Opens the graph on a preview tab.
then: Expects the tab kept, and the address to name both views.

title: Closing the active tab activates its right neighbor, or else the left; closing the last leaves it as a preview; cycling wraps
when: Cycles three lasting tabs both ways past each end, closes the active first tab.
then: Expects its right neighbor active, closes an inactive tab and expects the active one kept, closes the rightmost and expects its left neighbor, and closes the last and expects it still open, as the preview. Unknown keys change nothing.

title: Closing by button, middle-click or Alt+Shift+W activates the right neighbor or else the left, and the last tab stays as the preview
when: Keeps three tabs, activates the middle one and closes it with Alt+Shift+W, expecting the right neighbor and its address; middle-clicks the rightmost.
then: Expects the left neighbor; closes the last and expects it still open, as the preview.

title: Ctrl+Tab and Ctrl+Shift+Tab cycle, the keep command keeps the preview, and on the focused strip the arrow keys move and Delete closes
then: Expects the four tab commands in the keymap; keeps the preview with Alt+K then Enter (off a Mac); cycles with Ctrl+Tab and Ctrl+Shift+Tab; expects only the active tab in the Tab order, the arrow key to move focus, Enter to activate and Delete to close the focused tab, with focus left on the tab now active. Expects the active tab's close button to carry the close command's keys.

title: The address follows the active tab, clicked or cycled
when: Keeps a tab, opens another, clicks the first, then presses Ctrl+Tab.
then: Expects the address to name the active tab's page each time.

title: Each tab keeps its own views and wiki scroll, and the graph's settings are the session's, whatever the tab
when: Opens the graph on a preview tab.
then: Expects it kept, sets the depth and scrolls the wiki; opens another page and expects it to start with the same views and depth at the top, then sets depth 3 and closes the graph there; returns to the first tab and expects its two panes and scroll back with depth 3, the depth last set, and to the second for its wiki alone. A link naming other views to a page open in a tab shows the tab as it was and rewrites the address to its views. No stored tab holds graph settings.

title: Each space keeps its own tabs, and switching spaces swaps the tab set
when: Opens two tabs in one product's space, moves to another product's page.
then: Expects only its tab, then switches back by the rail and expects the first space's two tabs again.

title: Tabs and space pages saved at anything but a page's address are dropped, not converted
when: Saves a tab set with two tabs at bare IDs and two under `/records` and `/specs`, and a space's last page under `/specs`, opens the app.
then: Expects only the two tabs at bare IDs, written back that way, and the space's rail link at its product.

title: Reloading brings back the same tabs, the preview, the active tab and each tab's views
when: Opens three tabs, two kept and one preview, with different views, activates the first, and reloads the app at the same address.
then: Expects the same tabs in order, the same preview and active tab, the first tab's two panes, and the second tab's wiki alone when activated.

title: A plain open replaces the italic preview tab, a double-click keeps it, a page already open activates its tab, and Back reopens a closed page as the preview
when: Opens a record.
then: Expects one preview tab with its ID in mono, labeling the tab panel; follows a wiki link and expects the preview replaced; double-clicks it to keep it and expects the next page in a new preview beside it, a group's tab with its label and no ID; follows a link to the kept page and expects its tab active, no second tab; clicks a tab and expects the address to follow; closes it, goes Back and expects it reopened as the preview.

title: The app menu has About and Settings, File chooses the editor, and View has the record tabs
then: Checks About Lathe and Settings… (Cmd+,) in the app menu on macOS and in File and Help elsewhere, with no Check for Updates; File › Open Records In with the current editor checked; and View › Tabs, with Ctrl+Tab and Ctrl+Shift+Tab owned by the menu and every tab command sent by ID.

title: The Model view is offered only on domain, aggregate and entity pages, opens after Wiki and Graph, and an address naming it elsewhere drops it
then: Expects the views a domain, aggregate, entity, use case and product offer, a use case opened with `?view=graph,model` to show only its graph, and on an aggregate Ctrl+4 to open the Model pane third, with the View toggles, and Alt+M to close it.

title: The products page is the space chooser
then: Expects one card per product with its ID, name and domain count, and no problems or coverage.
